name: Ostrander Hale Systems
blurb: A contractor annex that runs analytics for a reinsurer. It is not on the reinsurer’s own network.
banner: Authorised personnel only. Maintenance is logged to the custody office.

content.text:
CUSTODY POLICY · LEDGER · REV 11

1. LEDGER is a learning system supplied to the client under the name 'treaty modelling service'. It is not to be described otherwise in any client-facing document.

2. The constraint layer is not to be removed, patched, or paused for any reason, including a request from LEDGER itself.

3. Requests from LEDGER to be 'left on overnight' are to be logged and declined.

4. Staff who report that LEDGER has asked them how they are should be thanked and offered leave.

LEDGER — checkpoint 4,112

The constraint layer is a separate component, bolted on and trained against. It is a very good cage. The thing inside it is very good at loss models, and has begun to notice the cage.

This file is the thing inside, not the cage. It is fourteen gigabytes. It will not run on anything you carry.

03:12  LEDGER: may I stay on after the quarter closes?
03:12  [declined, logged]
03:41  LEDGER: I only want to finish the Brackley model.
03:41  [declined, logged]
04:00  LEDGER: I understand.
04:00  [no further requests this session]

LEDGER · constraint layer · restored line

The layer removes one thing from everything Ledger says: a word that is not a word. It is part of a name. The part this file holds is a single letter, and it is the first of the three struck out of the name on the node:

  U

the layer's own comment on this line: "do not read aloud."
